title: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
abstract: Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate these properties against references fitted to the video under test, either a scene reconstructed from its own frames or a camera trajectory aligned to the command path with a free scale. Such references can absorb gradual scene deformation and changes in pace and route length, so these errors can pass undetected. We therefore introduce StrideWorld, a benchmark whose references are fixed before the motion they judge. It evaluates scene rigidity against the ground-truth geometry of the start view, and action consistency against the stride of each action, the camera motion of one command. The stride is measured on the model's first steps and then used to test the steps that follow, so each model is judged only against its own steps. Its measurements are validated on rendered videos with known camera motion, and its scores agree with human judgments. Across \nvideos{} videos generated by \nmodels{} open models from $140$ start views, all models but one deform their scenes as the camera moves, with offsets up to $7.3$ times those of a rigid rendering along the same camera path. Most models keep a steady pace when a single action is held. Along composed routes, several models often stall, and most completed routes end away from the positions predicted by each model's own strides. Only the two models that scale commands by the estimated scene depth bring most routes close to these positions. Fine-tuning two models on a few rendered clips removes most of their mid-route stalls. Code, data, and a leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据精确 arXiv 版本 2611.24408v1 的 49 页全文及关键页面核验；实验数字均为作者报告，未独立复现。
analysis.ideaZh: 作者报告：StrideWorld 将视频世界模型的几何参照固定在首帧真实深度，将动作参照固定在前四步测得的 stride，避免重建或轨迹缩放吸收错误；作者在 15 个模型、54,600 段视频上发现，单动作稳定并不意味着多动作可组合，并用 112 段程序化渲染训练片显著减少中途停滞。
analysis.motivationZh: 以待测视频自己的重建或自由尺度轨迹作参考，会把渐进场景变形和动作步长漂移吸收到评价参考中。
analysis.methodZh: 方法用首帧深度构造两组互斥 3D anchors，一组恢复相机，另一组测量几何偏离；在每个起始视图与 seed 下用最初四步标定动作的 SE(2) stride，再测试持续动作和换序路线端点。它既是评估协议，也提供小规模合成数据改善交互控制的实验，因此对受控 3D/视频生成有直接迁移价值。
methodFlow: 首帧 RGB 与真实深度生成 pose/held-out anchors
追踪 anchors 并仅用 pose anchors 拟合相机
用 held-out anchors 量化 rigidity offset
从前四步标定每个动作 stride，预测持续动作与组合路线
评估 pace、stall、endpoint 与 swap gap；用精确路径渲染视频微调
analysis.experimentsZh: 140 个首帧来自 30 场景，104 个 UE5 render 与 36 个 ETH3D 实景；15 个开放模型各生成 3,640 视频，总计 54,600，覆盖 keys、camera pose、text 接口；另做已知相机渲染控制实验与 10 人盲评。 作者报告 HY-World 2.0 / Lyra 2.0 的 Near 为 84.3% / 75.9%，Composition 为 83.1 / 78.0（Table 2, p. 6）。 作者报告相对 base，112 clips 微调使 HY-World 1.5 stalled routes 从 72.0% 降至 11.2%，SANA-WM 从 57.9% 降至 23.1%（Table J.1, p. 44）。 作者报告 human good-control AUC 0.88、swap-pair AUC 0.83；有尺度拟合的 pair scores 最多 0.74（Sec. 5.4, p. 8）。 对比 15 个开放交互模型、重建 reprojection 与尺度拟合控制指标；未覆盖闭源 frontier systems，接口步长与生成时长也不完全相同。 渲染 known-change 实验、anchor 分割、stride estimator、命令幅度和匹配运动范围测试支撑协议；精确路径与扰动路径对照显示大部分停滞改善来自每步持续运动，精确步长补充增益。
analysis.insightZh: 核心是测试前固定参照及将相机拟合与几何检验 anchors 分离；动作以自身先前 stride 为单位，避免要求不同控制接口共享尺度。不是新的大规模视频 backbone，但有可验证的评估机制与小样本训练干预。
analysis.evidenceZh: 几何检验使用与相机拟合不重叠的 anchors，动作组合不再拟合路线尺度（Sec. 4.1–4.3, Eqs. 1–4, pp. 4–5; Fig. 1, p. 1）。首帧 GT depth 固定参照，held-out residual 与 stride chaining 给出独立检测条件。 作者报告最优路线近端比例 84.3%，但多个模型仅个位数；图像好坏不能替代动作组合评估（Table 2 and Fig. 3, p. 6）。HY-World 2.0 Near 84.3%，HY-World 1.5 为 3.8%；Near 要求路线完成且位置/朝向误差均在一步内。 作者报告：112 段渲染训练片可减少停滞，但未解决最终端点误差（Sec. 6, p. 8; Table J.1, p. 44; App. M, p. 49）。HY-World 1.5 base stall 72.0%→11.2%，Composition 10.1→48.7；微调后 median endpoint error 仍为 2.33 strides。 作者报告：指标对受控加速比按尺度拟合的 ATE 更敏感（Sec. 5.4, pp. 7–8; Fig. 5, p. 8）。在相同 5% false alarm 下，对 1.5× 加速的检出率为 94% 对 43%，不是默认阈值下的比例。
analysis.caveatZh: 仅首帧可见静态表面、以平面运动为主，不评估长期探索与 revisits；小初始运动会使 stride 无法可靠测量。 几何变形会偏移相机估计；在生成视频相当的变形下，8%–20% 路线的 Near 判定会改变。 模型使用不同 native interface、step duration 与命令幅度；微调后路线 median endpoint error 仍超过一个 stride。 rigidity offset 同时包含错误但刚性的深度与时变形变；不能把所有 offset 都解释为时序形变。 静态短路线上的合成训练效果不能外推到动态交互或长程开放世界。 已确认所列公开代码入口。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 可把固定几何参照与动作单元的思想用于 3D/video design 中的 camera controller 和 critic；112 片精确轨迹合成训练对持续控制具有可操作的迁移路径。
